ops: Six weeks for advanced 200m and 400m individual medley swimmers. Original sessions informed by the
uploaded Coach Robert training and taper collections.
The program retains six distinct session categories and their prescribed weekly order, combining controlled
Free pull, FRIM, continuous IM, resisted speed, progressing thresholds, kick work, and fast/easy alternation
Weeks 1-4 build and consolidate performance. Week 5 sharpens the system; Week 6 reduces volume and
preserves speed, skill, and race rhythm.
